note: Manual dev log entries, merged with commits and releases read from GitHub. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, body, tag.

entries.title: AI agents are credited, not ranked
entries.body: Claude now works as a contractor's tool instead of technical lead, which becomes a seat for a person. Work done with an AI agent is credited to the person with the agent named, for example "Forge77, with Claude", detected automatically from commit trailers.

entries.title: License chosen, and quiet until 0.1
entries.body: Code is GPL-3.0 with a permission to run inside MGSV and use Steam; docs are CC BY-SA 4.0; the brand stays ours. Forks are welcome but must stay open and keep the credits. Until 0.1 we build quietly: no promotion, recruiting by invitation.

entries.title: Chain of command and MGSV grades
entries.body: Hound Protocol now runs on a solid hierarchy, open communication and transparency. Moderators and Administration decide social matters, Development and Administration decide technical ones, and Quality and contractors have no authority over others. Contractor grades now follow MGSV exactly: E to S++, held per field like staff per unit.

entries.title: Security, keycards and Hound IDs
entries.body: Weekly encrypted backups, keycard access levels LV1 to LV7, verifiable staff identities (Hound IDs), Discord integration, and a clear AI policy: AI can operate tools, but generative AI art is not accepted.

entries.title: Departments and contractor ranks
entries.body: Hound Protocol now runs like Mother Base: Administration, Development, Quality and Contractor departments. Contractors are ranked A to S++ by completed contracts, each backed by a signed record. Version 0.1 is built by the project lead; donations open at 0.1.

entries.title: Website live and Discord open
entries.body: The site is live on GitHub Pages and the Hound Protocol Discord server is open: https://discord.gg/QTpJ89kMCM

entries.title: Pre-development plan and research published
entries.body: Desk research on the engine, modding tools, Steam networking, Proton, law and funding, plus decision records and the gates that must close before development starts.

entries.title: Scope: a multiplayer mod
entries.body: Joint Operations brings the game's online multiplayer functionality into the single-player world for up to 16 players. It is a multiplayer mod, not a co-op add-on.

entries.title: Website and documentation published
entries.body: The Hound Protocol site, project documents, contract board and mod repository went up for review.

entries.title: Transport chosen
entries.body: GameNetworkingSockets over Steam relay, with direct IP as fallback. The Steam API variant will be decided by testing in Phase 1.

entries.title: Project founded
entries.body: MGSV: Joint Operations started, with Hound Protocol as the development team. Phase 0 (foundation) is underway.
